verdict.rationale: Sunbiz documents that filers can download an image of each processed annual report for free, which is a narrow, per-document way to take records out of the system. It does not show bulk export of all entity data, or export in open, machine-readable formats. Missing for 10: bulk export of all filings and entity data, open or structured export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON rather than report images), documented account-data portability or offboarding, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Once the annual report has been processed and posted, you can download an image of the report free of charge.
